text.p: Coates advised shareholders on Wednesday to continue exercising caution in dealings with company shares as negotiations to dispose of its can coatings business to Valspar Corporation of the U.S. were continuing.

It said it was envisaged that Coates would form a new subsidiary, ValsparCoates (SA) (Pty) Ltd and that, subject to the approval by the board on July 1, Valspar would take up 49 percent of the new company.
ValsparCoates would operate as a joint venture company for five years, after which Valspar would acquire the remaining 51 percent stake in the company.
Valspar is the largest worldwide supplier to the can decoration market and the deal would involve considerable technology transfer to the joint venture.
Shareholders would be asked to approve the deal, now being finalised, at a special meeting on June 25. It would not affect Coates' inks and resins divisions.
